quarterly_data.quarter: Kehua Data half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 detail (half-year report): net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 242,354,143.05, up 8.37% (net profit attributable up 62.69%); non-recurring gains totalled RMB 153,852,376.35, mainly investment income of RMB 189,688,253.51 (41.22% of total profit) from selling the equity of subsidiary Guangdong Keyun Chenhang Computing Technology on May 28, 2026, which produced an investment gain of RMB 1.85 hundred million (32.69% of net profit). Operating cash flow RMB 625,979,433.54 versus RMB -12,464,220.15 a year earlier. Within the data-center business, data-center products RMB 904,390,465.40 (up 15.32%, gross margin 31.10%, down 4.96 points) and IDC services RMB 686,309,127.69 (up 11.89%, gross margin 12.50%, down 8.27 points); data-center business gross margin down 6.28 points. Domestic revenue RMB 3,030,956,956.65, down 10.06%.
quarterly_data.figure: Recurring net profit RMB 242,354,143.05 (+8.37%); data-center products RMB 904,390,465.40 (+15.32%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kehua Data half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data-center products (half-year report): by end of June 2026 the elastic DC integrated cabinet co-developed with a major internet company had been delivered in more than 3000 units cumulatively; the company is co-developing a megawatt-class CDU for high-density liquid cooling with a major internet company; its DC products now cover 240V, 336V and 800V; it launched the Huiyun 8.0 modular data-center solution for general, intelligent and mixed computing.
quarterly_data.figure: Elastic DC integrated cabinet: more than 3000 units delivered cumulatively

quarterly_data.quarter: Kehua Data half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IDC operations (half-year report): the company operates more than 20 data centers in more than 10 cities with over 3.5 ten-thousand cabinets, in four clusters (North, East, South and Southwest China).

quarterly_data.quarter: Kehua Data half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Manufacturing (half-year report): in H1 2026 the Ningxia factory was completed and its first unit came off the line; the Xiang'an factory's production lines entered construction, which the company says lays the foundation for demand growth in H2; the Malaysia base's manufacturing capability kept rising. Mainstream product capacity rose sharply, and the company is working toward a capacity-doubling target through ATE automated testing and bottleneck fixes.
quarterly_data.figure: Ningxia factory completed; Xiang'an production lines under construction

quarterly_data.quarter: Kehua Data half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
